messages:
Sasha: T-45 until EU change window. Quick preflight — thumbs for go/no-go?
Zach: Smoke tests are green on canary-3, DB connections stable, CPU < 60%.
Mel: Release notes pushed to /release/notes/v2.4.1 — see summary and rollback links: https://go/release/241
Zach: Who's owning rollback if we see latency or 5xx spike after traffic shift?
Jamie: I'll own rollback. Rollback plan is pin+drain: pin service to v2.4.0, drain canaries, scale down new pools.
Jamie: Runbook snippet for quick ops:
```
kubectl rollout undo deployment/api --to-revision=36
deploy-bot pin-release --service api --version v2.4.0
```
Sasha: @deploy-bot start canary ramp to 10% (5m ramp).
deploy-bot: @Sasha canary ramp initiated — service=api target=10% duration=5m id=cb-873 :rocket:
Mel: Observability checklist: dashboards OK, synthetic health checks passing, alert thresholds set (latency >300ms for 5m => page).
Zach: I set uptimes and EMAs on the APM. Adding /standby channel for rapid comms and pager list.
Jamie: Quick ask — can we extend the quiet-window embargo by +30m? Nightly batch might overlap with slow roll.
Sasha: +1 to +30m. Ops, can you confirm embargo extension?
ops: ops: confirmed — quiet window extended by 30m. Will suppress non-critical pushes. :white_check_mark:
Zach: Last call: smoke, metrics, rollback owner assigned. Any objections?
Mel: No objections. Release notes and canary ID in the thread.
Sasha: OK — go for canary. Everyone keep eyes on latency and error rate for next 15m.
All: :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: ramp completed — 10% traffic steady (cb-873). Monitoring window started for 10m.
